tasks.title: Turn an image into a cinematic scene
tasks.summary: Use image-conditioned generation only when the owned image, job availability and cost checks permit it.

steps.instruction: Import the owned conditioning image and verify it is usable.
Request an image-conditioned moving shot through the existing reviewed workflow; retain conditioning evidence.
Watch the returned motion, accept the usable shot and import it into the canonical project.
Edit ordinary layers and sound, then render the current project.

tasks.title: Animate a person from an image
tasks.summary: Use the image-conditioned workflow and inspect identity/anatomy/motion; moving does not mean speaking.

steps.instruction: Import an owned or appropriately permitted image.
Request and review an image-conditioned moving scene if the capability is currently available.
Import only an accepted owned video and continue native editing.

tasks.expected_result: An accepted owned image-conditioned moving shot, when execution is available; no speaking/lip synchronization claim.
limitations: Image-conditioned motion is partial; talking/lip synchronization is unimplemented. No universal self-service person-animation availability is qualified.

tasks.title: Turn a podcast into a vertical promo

steps.instruction: If there are multiple cameras, synchronize them and verify clean-audio speaker mapping.
Select/review an excerpt or clip proposal; scores do not guarantee virality.
Reframe to the intended vertical view and inspect faces across the selected range.
Use reviewed caption phrases and listen to voice/music before final export.

tasks.expected_result: An owned editable result with current revision and reviewed output; inspect the actual moving picture and sound.
limitations: Automatic-word caption repetition remains broken; reviewed phrases are a limited subset.
Camera synchronization and deterministic final rendering remain authoritative.

tasks.title: Use Cam Combiner
tasks.summary: Align owned cameras and master audio, review the heuristic edit plan and send the result into Studio.

steps.instruction: Upload two or three camera sources and, when available, clean/master audio.
Synchronize and check alignment near the beginning, middle and end.
Review any estimated drift rate and recheck sync later in the recording; the automatic estimator is narrower than the time-mapping bounds.
Listen to isolated channels; swap and confirm speaker mapping if needed.
Generate/edit the activity-based switching plan and its reaction/split views.
Review reaction/split layouts and the selected source framing rather than relying on activity scores alone.
Watch/listen to the deterministic candidate, approve only a usable result and hand it into Studio.

tasks.expected_result: An owned editable result with current revision and reviewed output; inspect the actual moving picture and sound.
limitations: Follow the linked feature readiness; these steps do not promote the workflow to professional or production readiness.
aliases: difference between Cam Combiner and Director
